title: NIST O-RAN Testbed Automation Tool Version 1.7
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: NIST lists version 1.7 of its open-source automation scripts for operationalizing 5G O-RAN testbeds across bare-metal and virtualized environments.
key_findings: The release supports multiple user-equipment connections and split central and distributed unit configurations.
Documented capabilities include inter-DU handover, network-slice configuration, metrics collection, and visualization.
The page identifies experimentally verified component connections inside NIST testbeds.
why_it_matters: A versioned, documented tool is a reproducible implementation artifact that can support testing beyond the originating laboratory.
ftfn_relevance: Advances the O-RAN trail from project description to inspectable software release.
Creates follow-up gates for external use, published results, conformance, certification, and deployment.
evidence_limits: NIST does not warrant correctness or usefulness and does not claim commercial readiness.
The tool does not prove broad interoperability, security assurance, certification, or operator adoption.
